chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj from al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no harm in praying in the garments made by the Magians and the Christians and the Jews.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in clothes made by Christians or Jews?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib* clarifies that the garments of the People of the Book are ritually pure (*tahir*) by default, resolving the scholarly debate on whether their manufacturing process or specific status renders them impure (*najis*). It establishes a general principle of purity for their clothing, provided no visible impurity is present, reflecting the Shia view that their material goods are generally pure unless proven otherwise.
